Top with the panko and parmesan.Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden, with the broccoli florets tossed in the oil and salt on a second tray.Serve the mac and cheese with the broccoli.SweetsWhoville Christmas pudding with custardSteamed pudding and custard for the Whos' Welcome ChristmasHow to make it800g Christmas pudding500ml full cream milk100ml thickened cream4 eggs (yolks only)60g caster sugar1 tbsp cornflour1 tsp vanilla extract500ml vanilla ice cream1 jar Christmas sprinklesSteam the pudding in its basin over simmering water, or follow the packet.Warm the milk and cream.Whisk the yolks with the sugar and cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan.Stir over low heat until thick, then add the vanilla.Turn out the pudding, cut into wedges and serve with custard, ice cream and sprinkles.DrinksMax's frothy whipped hot chocolateFrothy chocolate, whipped cream and green sprinkles for a small heartHow to make it1 L full cream milk1 tbsp caster sugar150g milk chocolate, chopped2 tbsp cocoa powder150ml thickened cream1 tsp icing sugar1 jar green sprinklesHeat the milk with the sugar until steaming.Whisk in the chocolate and half the cocoa until melted and frothy, or blitz with a stick blender.Pour into mugs.Whip the cream with the icing sugar, spoon on top and finish with green sprinkles and the remaining cocoa dusted over.
